scope: Triage of the Almanax scan of PeridotFinance/PeridotV2-Robinhood @ c5d9086 (V3 concentrated liquidity merged). Scanner output is not an audit; this is a partial, theme-level triage. Only the six dismissals below were individually verified.
layerZero: No finding concerns LayerZero or any cross-chain component; none exists in this deployment.

dismissedInAlmanax.finding: Proxy can be hijacked via unprotected initialize (IsolatedMarginLiquidatorUpgradeable)
dismissedInAlmanax.evidence: Constructor calls _disableInitializers: the implementation 0x868d...e3a2 reads initialized = 2^64-1, the live proxy 0x1434...083c reads 1. Read on-chain 2026-10-09.

dismissedInAlmanax.finding: Initializer callable by anyone if left uninitialized (IsolatedMarginExecutorUpgradeable)
dismissedInAlmanax.evidence: Same: implementation 0xd44a...fbd8 locked (2^64-1), live proxy 0x6A45...8977 initialized (1).

dismissedInAlmanax.finding: Oracle price not revalidated after recenter (RangeLib)
dismissedInAlmanax.evidence: RangeLib.recenter ends with guard.validatePoolPrice and the vault re-checkpoints at the oracle reference; covered by fork tests.

dismissedInAlmanax.finding: Strict balance delta checks enable griefing DoS (RangeLib)
dismissedInAlmanax.evidence: Deltas are measured inside one call; a donation before the call does not change them; fixed plain ERC-20s; fee-on-transfer reverting is intended.

dismissedInAlmanax.finding: Recenter range may exceed tick bounds (RangeLib)
dismissedInAlmanax.evidence: Fails closed: adapter setRange rejects ticks outside the usable bounds (InvalidRange, tested).

dismissedInAlmanax.finding: Ranged removals always permit extra 1% slack (UniswapV4PairedAdapterV3)
dismissedInAlmanax.evidence: Design parameter (REMOVAL_BUFFER_BPS) matching the registration invariant; removal value is also bounded by oracle-anchored floors and the removal gate.

remainingByTheme.theme: Governance and centralization (owner/executor/liquidator/proxy-admin powers, emergency setters, no upgrade delay on some proxies)
remainingByTheme.disposition: Known trust assumption, not a code defect. Proposer, keeper, guardian and market admins are one bootstrap key behind a 1h timelock; Safe migration is outstanding and disclosed in the README (Known limitations).

remainingByTheme.theme: Oracle freshness: cached/manual fallback in the lending oracle; zero price or oracle revert freezing margin or closes
remainingByTheme.disposition: Disclosed. The ordinary-lending price source keeps its original cached/manual fallback (README); margin and the vault guard fail closed by design.

remainingByTheme.theme: Fee-on-transfer, rebasing, non-standard or decimals-dependent token behavior
remainingByTheme.disposition: Tokens are the two fixed tokens configured at registration. Strict balance-delta checks are intentional (they revert instead of corrupting the ledger). Residual risk: a corporate-action multiplier on the tokenized stock would need a governance response.

remainingByTheme.theme: Compound-derived arithmetic and admin setters (division helpers, rounding, close factor, liquidation incentive, oracle address, market entries, borrow index cap)
remainingByTheme.disposition: Inherited, admin-only or unreachable at current parameters; not individually verified.

remainingByTheme.theme: Remediation code: stale NAV between checkpoints, vault pair cap and aggregate cap not applied to fee credits, guardian can halt a pair, silent vault-deposit failures in the delegate
remainingByTheme.disposition: Acknowledged design limits. Checkpoints run at least hourly (maxCheckpointAge 3600); the pair cap ($1000) and aggregate cap are far above current size; the guardian can only pause (never unpause); delegate failures emit events and are documented as operator traps.

remainingByTheme.theme: Peridot governance token (Comp-style delegateBySig malleability, zero-address constructor, max-allowance sentinel)
remainingByTheme.disposition: Standard Comp-token pattern, low impact; the token is deployed on this chain (0xbD6f...A548). Not individually verified.

notDone: The remaining 96 findings were not dismissed or resolved in Almanax. No claim is made that they are all non-issues.
